mainEntity.name: Is this certificate generator really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The form fields update the recipient name, organization, date, and achievement text live in the preview. Every template is plain HTML and CSS under the hood, so with a free account you can edit the template code directly, or describe the design you want and let the AI Template Maker write it.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize the certificate design?

acceptedAnswer.text: This free tool generates high-quality PNG images at 1920x1080 resolution. With a free account, the API and workflows also render certificates as PDF (including multi-page), JPG, and WebP.

mainEntity.name: What formats can I download certificates in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Pictify works as a bulk certificate generator for events, training programs, and courses. Upload a CSV in a workflow (one row per attendee) and every row renders its own certificate. Or use the API to batch generate up to 500 certificates per call. Perfect for course completions, event attendance, and employee recognition programs.

mainEntity.name: Can I bulk generate certificates for events or training programs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, this is what makes Pictify different from other certificate makers. A batch run renders every row of your CSV against the same template in one job, and hands back a CDN link per certificate plus a per-row status you can poll. A webhook fires when the run finishes, so your own system can pick the files up without anyone watching a progress bar.

mainEntity.name: Can I generate certificates in bulk automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Export your Sheet as CSV and upload it to a workflow; columns map to certificate variables in the wizard. Unlike Sheets add-ons such as Autocrat, the merge runs on managed infrastructure (no Apps Script 6-minute timeouts) and delivery never touches your Gmail quota.

mainEntity.name: Can I generate certificates from Google Sheets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every workflow exposes a signed webhook. Point your LMS completion event, Typeform, or a Zapier/Make/n8n flow at it and each payload renders one certificate, with the same per-row status tracking as a CSV run.

mainEntity.name: Can my LMS or form tool trigger certificates automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. In a workflow, templates are HTML: drop an tag with your logo URL anywhere in the design, or upload it as a brand asset. Because templates are code, there is no limit on layout, fonts, or imagery.

mainEntity.name: Can I add my company logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, certificates are generated at 1920x1080 pixels which provides excellent print quality for standard certificate sizes. For best results, print on high-quality paper or card stock.
